subject.title: [Feature]: Structured Callback Actions and Thread Context Inheritance for Agent Handoffs

question: Should OpenClaw add typed `sessions_send` handoff actions/acknowledgements and explicit announce routing/thread overrides now, or keep this as acceptance coverage for a broader A2A handoff contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes model-facing tool/API semantics and message-delivery behavior, and related open work overlaps without providing a safe merged canonical implementation.

options.title: Keep As Handoff Acceptance Work
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the next accepted A2A handoff implementation to cover structured skip/no-reply outcomes plus channel/target/thread inheritance tests.

options.title: Approve A Narrow sessions_send Contract
options.body: Add an additive `sessions_send` action or acknowledgement shape plus explicit announce target/thread overrides while preserving current sentinel behavior and defaults.

options.title: Delegate To The Draft Acknowledgement PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83094 or a successor only after storage, redaction, proof, and API vocabulary blockers are resolved.

recommendation.title: Keep As Handoff Acceptance Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the next accepted A2A handoff implementation to cover structured skip/no-reply outcomes plus channel/target/thread inheritance tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the explicit keep-open triage direction and has the strongest sampled feature-history signal for the sessions_send/A2A contract surface.
